# C4 Studios

> C4 Studios is a founder-led design, development and AI studio based in Perth,
> Western Australia. We build custom high-performance websites, AI automations
> and agents, private AI systems, brand photography, videography, motion
> graphics, SEO and copywriting.

C4 Studios operates across four arms under one roof:

- **Web** — custom websites and web apps, redesigns, e-commerce, landing pages and ongoing support.
- **C4i (AI)** — AI automations, agents, workflow automation, and private AI systems that run on your own hardware or in the cloud.
- **C4 Lens** — brand photography, videography, drone/aerial work and motion graphics.
- **SEO & copywriting** — technical SEO, on-page work, monthly articles and website copy.

Founded 2022 by Caleb Scott. Serving Perth, Fremantle and Western Australia
(and remote clients Australia-wide). Every project is delivered directly by the
person building it.

## Case studies

- [Transform Fremantle](https://c4studios.com.au/CaseStudy/transform-fremantle): Website design and build for a Fremantle wellness business.
- [Transform Hakea](https://c4studios.com.au/CaseStudy/transform-hakea): Website design and build for Transform Hakea.
- [HVN CrossFit](https://c4studios.com.au/CaseStudy/hvn-gym): Website and brand content for a CrossFit gym.
- [Jurassic PT](https://c4studios.com.au/CaseStudy/jurassic-pt): Website rebuild for a personal training business.
- [Tidy Gardens Australia](https://c4studios.com.au/CaseStudy/tidy-gardens-australia): Website for a Perth gardening and landscaping business.
- [RocksStream — The Rocks Church](https://c4studios.com.au/CaseStudy/rocksstream): Motion graphics and interactive content for a church media series.
- [GoCC](https://c4studios.com.au/CaseStudy/gocc): Website performance and functionality overhaul.
- [Sharp Bricklaying](https://c4studios.com.au/CaseStudy/sharp-bricklaying): Website for a Perth bricklayer, with drone aerials and a multi-job gallery.
- [Brady Electrical](https://c4studios.com.au/CaseStudy/brady-electrical): Website for a Neerabup electrician, built around a live single-line diagram of the Perth metro.
- [Aqua-Safe Plumbing & Maintenance](https://c4studios.com.au/CaseStudy/aqua-safe-plumbing): Website for a Perth plumbing and gas fitting business, organised by problem and by suburb.
